'''''239''''' was one of over 50 [[stasis probe]]s that were launched by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Alpha Blue]] intelligence agency to observe the [[N'zoth system/Legends|N'zoth system]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. ''239'' was one of only three probes to survive the mission and warned [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic forces]] of the incoming [[Yevetha]]n [[Black Fleet]].<ref name="TT" />
